sample_spec._doc: Refreshed 2026-11-19 against DO's models and pricing pages (both last verified 18 Nov 2026) and DO's Nov 2026 retirement notices: deepseek-v4-pro, mimo-v2.5-pro and deepseek-3.2 carry deprecation_date 2026-11-23 (DO returns 404 model_not_found after that; successors deepseek-v4-pro-0813, glm-5.3 and deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017) and stay in the feed until then so their last days are costed at DO's current prices; deepseek-v4-pro repriced to $1.74/$3.48/$0.348 and deepseek-3.2 to $0.50/$1.60/$0.15 per MTok; deepseek-v4-pro-0813 cache read corrected to DO's published $0.044; deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017 added (1,048,576 ctx and output, native vision); mimo-v2.5-pro curated (262,144 ctx, text only) so a discovered row gets real pricing for its last days. Removed llama-4-maverick, deepseek-4-flash, qwen3.5-397b-a17b and openai-gpt-oss-20b, which DO deprecated from serverless on 10 Nov 2026: the nightly sync marks their rows deprecated (still routable, never deleted) and the deprecation alert flags any policy that references them. Earlier: refreshed 2026-09-04 against docs.digitalocean.com/products/inference/details/pricing (page last verified 1 Sep 2026) and the serverless models page: DeepSeek V4 Pro and V4 Flash repriced and widened to 1M context; GA variants deepseek-v4-pro-0813 and deepseek-v4-flash-0731 added; cache_read kept at the 25%-of-input ratio the existing entries use; qwen3.8-max gains vision because DO now documents text, image and video input for it. Kimi K2.5/K2.6 were documented multimodal when first curated but the models page no longer states a modality for them - kept pending a live probe (Q-089). First-party curated catalog for DigitalOcean Gradient serverless inference (Q-061). Open-source models only — the platform's commercial Anthropic/OpenAI models are reachable through their own provider kinds with the firm's own keys, which is the product's compliance story. Shape mirrors LiteLLM entries (costs are USD per TOKEN). Sources: docs.digitalocean.com/products/inference/details/models + /pricing, retrieved 2026-07-29, pricing refreshed 2026-09-03 (DO page 'last verified 1 Sep 2026'; qwen3.5-397b-a17b rose from $0.385/$2.45 to $0.55/$3.50 per MTok, cache read unchanged). 2026-09-03 additions for Vibe 1040 (item E1): glm-5.3-flash (1,048,576 ctx, text+image+video per DO docs → vision true), glm-5.3 (1,048,576 ctx, text only), qwen3.8-max (1,000,000 ctx per DO models page; vision was deliberately left unset on 2026-09-03 while DO listed image input on one page only; set true on 2026-09-04 once the models page documented text, image and video input). Capabilities: json_schema is set true across DO chat models (Q-083 — DO's inference API is OpenAI-compatible and JSON/structured output is broadly supported, so these are selectable for cloud JSON task classes out of the box); tools is left unset (= false, DO documents tool calling only for its commercial models) and operators enable it per model via capability overrides after verifying against their account; vision is set only where DO documents multimodal input (GLM-5.3 Flash, Qwen3.8-Max, Kimi K3; Kimi K2.5/K2.6 kept from the original read, see the 2026-09-04 note); caching only where DO publishes a cached-input price. kimi-k3 carries no max_input_tokens because DO has not published its context window — the sync treats such entries as ENRICH-ONLY (Q-088): they never create a catalog row, but enrich a discovered row's capabilities and pricing in place, leaving its operator-editable specs alone.
